listeners:

Proto Recv-Q Send-Q Local Address           Foreign Address         State       
tcp        0      0 0.0.0.0:22              0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN      
tcp        0      0 :::22                   :::*                    LISTEN

root_mount:
/ rootfs rw
/ jffs2 ro,relatime
/tmp tmpfs rw,nodev,relatime,size=524288k
ipv4_input:
-P INPUT DROP
-A INPUT -m pkttype --pkt-type multicast -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -j ipsec_vpn
-A INPUT -j anti_attack
-A INPUT -j SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT
-A INPUT -j SCL_IP_DROP
-A INPUT -j upnp_blacklist
-A INPUT -j dhcp_lanportmap
-A INPUT -j secondary_lan_in
-A INPUT -j service_list
-A INPUT -j dhcp_relay
-A INPUT -j gre_tunnel
-A INPUT -j l2tp_tunnel
ipv6_input:
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-A INPUT -j SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT_V6
-A INPUT -j SCL_IP_DROP_V6
-A INPUT -j service_list
